tasks.short: Discuss editorial issues and establish priorities.

steps.what: Retrieve current story assignments, deadlines and previously agreed editorial positions
Discuss issues with editors to establish priorities or positions, including disagreement and uncertainty
outputs: actual agreed priorities and unresolved positions

steps.what: Write the actual editorial decisions and deadlines using native story links and assignment fields
inputs: actual agreed priorities and unresolved positions

steps.what: Approve the complete decision note as an accurate record of the discussion
Commit the approved decision note to the internal newsroom assignment record

tasks.design: Configure a current assignment view and linked decision fields in {OTHER}, the newsroom assignment system, with {DOCS} references. The journalist still discusses priorities and captures actual decisions; native field reuse reduces link and deadline copying before complete-note review and a separate internal commit. Changes void approval, and neither the discussion nor the tool creates an external publication or automatically changes editorial policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Story context and discussion conclusions are copied between notes and assignment records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and note fields can reduce administrative repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Editorial disagreements and changing news priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Argue a position, listen and recognize what remains unresolved.

ambition.what: Keep current editorial decisions easier to trace.

tasks.altitude: Editorial discussions and decision rights stay with people.

reach.learn: Refer to the actual agreed priorities and unresolved issues.

evidence.claim: Newsroom assignment tools can link story records and capture decisions in native fields.

assumptions: Existing story owners supply assignments and deadlines in normal work. s1 includes missing context checks; s3 counts actual conclusion capture, with no clean decision record assumed.
This is a journalist's internal discussion note, not authority to alter the editor's policy. No automated message is proposed.
unknowns: Whether current assignment views already avoid context copying.
research_questions: Which administrative fields are recopied after editorial discussions?

already_counted.description: Actual decision capture and complete-note review.

incremental.description: Maintain linked assignment and decision fields.

approvals.approved_version: approved editorial decision note version and internal assignment record target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Five context lookup, three field-copying and five filing hours saved, less one upkeep hour. Existing native views may already provide the benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather and verify actual news developments and additional information with exact source references
inputs: primary reporting evidence and current developments
outputs: verified blog evidence and exact permitted quotations

steps.what: Choose the blog entry's perspective and distinguish established news from the journalist's opinion
inputs: verified blog evidence and exact permitted quotations

steps.what: Write the online blog entry addressing news developments and the chosen commentary using a bounded prose draft
inputs: verified blog evidence and exact permitted quotations

loop.purpose: Draft prose that expresses the journalist's chosen argument
loop.input: Explicit outline, verified facts and exact permitted quotations
loop.check: Journalist compares meaning, factual claims, opinion labels and every quote with source evidence
loop.stop: Invented claim or quote is rejected; two edits maximum before manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native blog templates handle layout but not new prose; original opinion and reporting remain human inputs.

steps.what: Verify and edit the complete blog preview for factual accuracy, attribution and intended opinion
inputs: verified blog evidence and exact permitted quotations

steps.what: Independently review and approve the complete final blog preview and public publication target
Publish only the exact editor-approved online blog version

tasks.design: Use native blog templates in {CMS} and a bounded prose loop fed only permitted verified facts and the journalist's own argument in {DOCS}. The journalist checks factual meaning, opinion and quotations, followed by independent editor review of the complete preview before a separate public publication action. Any edit cancels approval, confidential material stays outside the model, and the tool invents neither quotes nor opinions for the journalist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Draft prose preparation follows already completed reporting and argument selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded writing assistance can express an explicit human outline in the native blog layout.
tasks.still_hard: Developing a justified perspective and separating commentary from fact.
tasks.human_edge: Own the argument and its treatment of people and evidence.

ambition.what: Write current news blog coverage with less draft preparation.

tasks.altitude: Reporting, opinions and editorial release remain human responsibilities.

reach.learn: Check evidence and intended argument against the complete preview.

evidence.claim: Bounded language-model drafting can express supplied facts and an outline, but no task-specific saving or accuracy is established.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and include ten editor hours. Journalist denominator is 90 hours; editor time remains full.
s1 captures actual evidence, source, date and permitted exact quotation. s2 produces the intended opinion and outline; missing evidence is resolved manually.
s3 includes draft checks, s4 complete verification and s5 independent approval. Native templates are tested before any custom draft integration.
unknowns: Editorial input restrictions and existing native draft workflow.
research_questions: Does prose assistance save preparation after all quote and meaning checks?

incremental.description: Maintain draft input restrictions and review recurrent errors.

approvals.approved_version: editor-approved blog version including complete preview and public target

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Nine drafting and five publishing-handling hours saved from a 90-hour journalist baseline gives 15.56% gross, less two upkeep. Low case assumes no drafting gain and publishing already configured, leaving upkeep only.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write columns, editorials, commentaries and reviews.

steps.what: Retrieve event references, review notes and exact citations needed for the opinion piece
inputs: existing evidence and personal review notes

steps.what: Interpret events and develop the journalist's opinion, counterarguments and critical judgement
Write columns, editorials, commentaries or reviews expressing the original argument and personal voice
Proofread the opinion piece with native spelling and terminology checks while manually checking facts and meaning
Review and approve the exact final opinion piece for internal editorial staging
Commit the approved opinion piece to the internal editorial staging record

tasks.design: Configure native reference views in {OTHER}, the newsroom archive and editorial staging system, and existing proofreading rules in {DOCS}. The journalist still develops and writes the original opinion; only reference navigation, spelling checks and separately approved internal staging lose time. The editor approves the complete corrected text before commitment, changes void approval, and public publication remains a later newsroom action with its own release control.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation, mechanical proofreading and staging add repetition around original writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native archive links and proofreading rules can reduce those specific steps.
tasks.still_hard: Original thought, voice and fair interpretation of contested events.
tasks.human_edge: Stand behind an opinion grounded in experience and evidence.

ambition.what: Reduce mechanical work around original opinion writing.

tasks.altitude: Original authorship and editorial judgement remain human.

reach.learn: Use the authored argument while correcting mechanical errors.

evidence.claim: LanguageTool checks spelling, grammar and punctuation; this supports proofreading capability, not the proposed labour percentage.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and include five editor hours. Journalist denominator is 95 hours; editor work is retained.
The journalist's normal reporting and direct review experience produce source material; s1 includes missing-reference checks and s2 captures the original argument.
Only mechanical check handling decreases in s4; factual and meaning review remains full within retained time.
No model writes the opinion or invents a review experience.
unknowns: Current native archive and proofing configuration.
research_questions: Which mechanical checks remain after existing spelling tools are configured?

incremental.description: Maintain approved terminology and archive view fields.

approvals.approved_version: editor-approved opinion-piece version and internal staging destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Six reference, two mechanical proofreading and five staging hours saved from a 95-hour journalist baseline gives 13.68% gross, less one upkeep. Existing archive and proofing configuration may already provide this benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve verified commentary references, broadcast brief and the current programme rundown
inputs: existing verified story records and rundown

steps.what: Prepare the journalist's commentary cues with native source, name and timing fields
Present recorded commentary via broadcast media using the journalist's own voice, including necessary retakes
Review the actual recorded commentary for meaning, factual accuracy and delivery and finalize the recording
outputs: complete final commentary recording and metadata

steps.what: Review and approve the exact final recording, metadata and internal broadcast producer destination
inputs: complete final commentary recording and metadata

steps.what: Send the exact approved recording and metadata to the named internal broadcast producer

tasks.design: Configure source-linked cues and exact recording handoff in {OTHER}, the newsroom rundown, recording and media-asset system, using verified references in {DOCS}. The journalist still writes the commentary, performs it and checks the actual recording; only reference and cue-field copying and internal transfer handling change. The editor approves the completed recording before a separate internal handoff, edits invalidate approval, and this tool performs no live broadcast or synthetic voice generation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference and cue details and recorded assets are copied between newsroom and broadcast tools.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rundown fields and media-asset transfer can reuse exact source and recording identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Clear delivery, accuracy and editorial judgement under time pressure.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret events and convey commentary in an accountable human voice.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation and handoff around current recorded commentary.

tasks.altitude: The journalist remains the commentator; editors retain release control.

reach.learn: Receive the exact reviewed recording and metadata.

evidence.claim: Newsroom rundown and media-asset tools can reuse source metadata and transfer selected recording versions internally.

assumptions: This graph covers the recorded branch of the task; live delivery remains human and cannot use approval of an as-yet unspoken final recording.
Shares are provisional and include ten editor hours; journalist baseline is 90. No unattended recording or playout runtime is counted.
s2 captures intended commentary and verifies names and cue timings; s3 creates actual audio and s4 creates final metadata. Missing references remain manual in s1.
Public playout is the producer's separate release action; only the journalist's internal transfer handling is credited here.
unknowns: Current native rundown and recording-transfer integration.
research_questions: Which cue and transfer fields require repeated entry today?

already_counted.description: Journalist review of actual recorded content.

incremental.description: Maintain cue field mappings and exact-version transfer checks.

approvals.approved_version: editor-approved recording version including exact audio, metadata and internal producer destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Six reference, three cue-copying and five transfer-handling hours saved from a 90-hour journalist baseline gives 15.56% gross, less one upkeep. Native integration may already remove this work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Editorial discussion and original commentary retain human authorship, supported by native reference and handoff tools.
reach: Editors and broadcast producers receive exact completed artifacts and retain release decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Spend less time copying context and moving completed work while preserving original thought and editorial responsibility.
